articles.title: ‘Orwellian’: HIV scientist’s ordeal lays bare Trump officials’ interference in grant-making
articles.description: Researchers forced to scrap original studies as NIH rethinks grants not in ‘alignment’ with administration’s priorities Dr Jade Pagkas-Bather received her first grant from the National Institutes of Health (NIH) in June 2025 – a milestone in any researcher’s career. She planned to study basic income as a medical intervention: her randomized control trial would test whether monthly grants of $500-cash helped poor, HIV-positive young people in Chicago stick with treatment. Her hypothesis was as straightforward as it was cutting. Continue reading...

articles.title: Nasa’s Voyager 1 probe in sight of an incredible milestone – podcast

source.name: Presented and produced by Madeleine Finlay, sound design by Joel Cox, the executive producer was Ellie Bury

articles.description: Nasa sent the Voyager 1 and 2 probes into space almost 50 years ago to explore the outer reaches of our solar system. Now Voyager 1, the farthest human-made object from Earth, is about to reach a distance of one light-day away from our planet. To find out more about its astonishing journey, Madeleine Finlay hears from Jim Bell, a planetary scientist and professor at Arizona State University’s school of Earth and space exploration.
